verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (logo, product, headline, price and Shop), but the two-line headline nearly fills the 90px height with almost no top or bottom margin, the 'Obsidian Buds, $179' line is tiny, and the Shop button sits tight against the right edge.
